description: Lorelai and Rory deal with the consequences of major relationship changes as Rory finishes Yale and both women face futures that require leaving familiar patterns behind.

s07e01.description: Lorelai wakes beside Christopher after ending things with Luke and must confront what she has done, while Logan leaves Rory a cryptic parting gift before settling in London.

s07e02.description: Lane returns from a disastrous honeymoon and discovers she is pregnant, while Luke struggles to explain to Liz and T.J. that his engagement to Lorelai is over.

s07e03.description: Friday dinner and a cotillion force Lorelai to question how much of her adult life has been shaped by doing the opposite of whatever her parents expected.

s07e04.description: Lorelai and Christopher begin dating openly, Rory meets new artistic friends at Yale, April temporarily stays with Luke and Emily has an unfortunate encounter with the police.

s07e05.description: A derailed shipment fills Stars Hollow with the smell of pickles, while Lorelai and Christopher argue after Sherry suddenly wants a greater role in Gigi’s life.

s07e06.description: Lorelai and Christopher join Emily and Richard for Yale Parents’ Weekend, while Luke accepts an awkward date and continues adjusting to being an active father to April.

s07e07.description: Christopher takes Lorelai to Paris and pushes their relationship toward marriage, while Rory remains uncertain about life after Yale and Lane learns she is expecting twins.

s07e08.description: Rory reacts badly when Lorelai and Christopher reveal their marriage, and Lorelai quietly helps Luke when April becomes ill and he needs someone he can trust.

s07e09.description: Lorelai tries to make Christopher feel at home in Stars Hollow, while holding his newborn niece prompts Luke to reconsider how hard he should fight for access to April.

s07e10.description: Holiday tensions erupt across Stars Hollow as Rory fights with Logan and Lucy, Luke battles Anna over April, and Christopher confronts Luke over Lorelai.

s07e11.description: Lane fears motherhood will erase her identity, while Lorelai secretly writes a strong character reference for Luke’s custody case without telling Christopher.

s07e12.description: Christopher discovers Lorelai’s heartfelt reference for Luke and recognizes feelings she has not resolved, while Sookie and Jackson face unexpected news about another pregnancy.

s07e13.description: Richard suffers a heart attack and the family gathers at the hospital, where Luke arrives to help while Christopher remains conspicuously absent despite Lorelai’s repeated calls.

s07e14.description: Lorelai organizes a memorial for Michel’s dog while her marriage to Christopher finally collapses under the weight of their unresolved expectations and her feelings for Luke.

s07e15.description: Lorelai tells Emily that her marriage has ended, while Logan’s risky business acquisition fails and forces him to confront the consequences of acting without enough caution.

s07e16.description: Lorelai mediates a Kim family dispute before Lane’s baby shower, while Logan finally admits his business failure to Rory and escapes to Las Vegas with old friends.

s07e17.description: Lorelai, Rory and Emily travel together to Mia’s wedding in North Carolina, while Zack asks Luke for advice about becoming a father and Logan begins taking responsibility seriously.

s07e18.description: A giant hay-bale maze brings Lorelai and Luke into a long-overdue honest conversation, while Rory’s uncertainty over post-graduation jobs grows increasingly unlike her usual decisiveness.

s07e19.description: Luke helps Lorelai shop for a replacement car and their old ease begins returning, while Paris considers whether her relationship with Doyle should influence her graduate-school choice.

s07e20.description: During karaoke night, Lorelai’s performance makes her lingering feelings for Luke obvious to everyone, while Logan arrives in Stars Hollow preparing to ask a consequential question.

s07e21.description: Rory graduates from Yale and Logan proposes marriage, forcing her to choose between committing to his planned future and keeping her own still-uncertain possibilities open.

s07e22.description: Rory accepts a reporting job covering Barack Obama’s campaign, and Luke secretly organizes a townwide farewell party that gives Lorelai and Rory one last Stars Hollow gathering before she leaves.
